Name: Particle Framework
Author: FearGodFishFish
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/how-to-use.png[/img]
This framework uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to designate custom particle effects to:
[list]
[*]Farmers wearing specific equipment or wielding specific tools / weapons
[*]Specific-named NPCs
[*]Specific object ItemIDs
[*]Specific furniture ItemIDs
[*]Specific coordinates on a named game location
[/list]
This framework also has an API for modders who want to add custom functionality in their C# mods

[url=https://github.com/Smoked-Fish/ParticleFramework/blob/main/README.md]Go to the GitHub [/url] for more info on how to use

This mod is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11056]Particle Effects[/url]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/my-other-mods.png[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Build and Place Anything Anywhere[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]
[/list]
